collectd_autoload_plugin.description: If true, plugins are loaded automatically with default options when a <Plugin> block is encountered.

collectd_basedir.description: Base directory for collectd data files.

collectd_collect_internal_stats.description: If true, internal collectd statistics are collected.

collectd_fqdn_lookup.description: If enabled, FQDN lookup is performed for the hostname.

collectd_hostname.description: The hostname of the machine where collectd is running.

collectd_interval.description: Interval at which to query values (in seconds).

collectd_log_logstash_file.description: Path to the log file for the log_logstash plugin.

collectd_max_read_interval.description: Maximum interval for reading data (in seconds).

collectd_pidfile.description: PID file location for the collectd daemon.

collectd_plugin_dir.description: Directory where collectd plugins are stored.

collectd_read_threads.description: Number of threads for reading data.

collectd_syslog_log_level.description: Log level for the syslog plugin.

collectd_typesdb.description: Path to the types.db file defining metric types.

collectd_write_queue_limit_high.description: High watermark for the write queue limit.

collectd_write_queue_limit_low.description: Low watermark for the write queue limit.

collectd_write_threads.description: Number of threads for writing data.
